body.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE vertical painted adventure world-map terrain strip, 1024x1536, made of FOUR vertically stacked contiguous REGIONS, not a finished interface. Source image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for painterly Russian fairy-tale landscapes, realistic miniature wooden villages, birches, deep pine forests, antique gold sunset light, dark navy shadows and winding river geography. Render from consistent high three-quarter aerial map view, close enough that each region is a distinct dramatic landmark, NOT distant panoramic scenery. Entire image filled with terrain; no sky or horizon. EXACTLY FOUR equal-height regions, one per vertical quarter, each with a large readable centerpiece alternating left/right. Soft organic wooded boundaries between regions, NO hard card frames or horizontal rules. Continuous narrow winding earth road connects all four regions from TOP to BOTTOM. Four landmarks must remain inside their own quarter with foliage at top/bottom edges. Keep the lowest 20% of each quarter subdued and uncluttered for separately overlaid native chapter name. Rich but controlled detail, warm lanterns, restrained highlights, legible silhouettes at phone size. NO UI, text, lettering, numbers, labels, emblems, nodes, gold dotted lines, circles, lock icons, panels, portraits, hero characters, frames, borders, watermarks. Treat narrative only as location guidance, do not render story scenes or characters. Regions top to bottom:
ZONE 1, vertical band 0-25%: Trunk of the World Tree. Theme: Ascent, reunion, growing power. Story setting: Climbing the endless trunk. Allies from almost every previous chapter return to help — Leshy, the Sea Tsar’s gift, the Bear spirit, Morozko’s frost, the eastern dragons, and the three bogatyrs in growing strength. The levels become larger and more collaborative in feel.
ZONE 2, vertical band 25-50%: The Heavenly Halls. Theme: Divine light, final preparation, blessing. Story setting: The upper world. Halls of pure light, where the highest spirits and the memory of the old gods still linger. The hero receives the final blessing and the ultimate form of Matching Magic — the ability to create Living Lights that can permanently push back darkness.
ZONE 3, vertical band 50-75%: The Realm of Chernobog. Theme: Darkness, despair, the ultimate test. Story setting: Almost all color is gone. The boards are dark, the music is heavy, the difficulty is the highest in the game. Companions are temporarily separated or weakened. The hero must fight through nightmare versions of previous locations — twisted forests, frozen villages, shadowed Moscow.
ZONE 4, vertical band 75-100%: The Rebirth of Rus. Theme: Triumph, sacrifice, new beginning. Story setting: The final battle. All companions return. The three bogatyrs fight at full power. Baba Yaga arrives in her mortar with unexpected help. The Firebird burns with her complete golden fire. Vasilisa stands beside the hero. The Matching Magic reaches its peak — entire boards can be cleared in cascades of pure light.
